new Promise(res=>{const P=window.__player; const out=[]; let n=0; const iv=setInterval(()=>{ out.push([P.exert.toFixed(2), P.speed.toFixed(2), P.ch.curName.replace('m_','')]); if(++n>=12){clearInterval(iv); res(JSON.stringify(out));} },1000);})
